text:
emma-support: Heads up — customer DataPulse flagged an incorrect credit after a mid-cycle downgrade. Invoice `INV-2026-1345` shows a full credit note instead of a prorated amount. PO on file: `PD-778`. VAT was applied on the credit (20%) but original invoice was 0% (edu exemption). Customer expecting partial refund.

liam-finance: Oof. Can you paste the invoice + credit note numbers and amounts? Also which payment method they used?

emma-support: Sure — summary: 
```
Invoice: INV-2026-1345  amount_charged: 600.00 GBP  tax_rate: 0%  PO: PD-778  paid_with: card_ending_4242
Credit created: CN-9987  amount: 120.00 GBP  tax_rate: 20%  created_by: billing-service v2
```
Customer says they were downgraded mid-cycle and expect ~80.00 GBP credit, not 120.00.

alex-engineer: I pulled the billing-service logs for CN-9987 — we returned HTTP 200 when creating the credit, but upstream tax normalization step used the customer's current tax profile not the original invoice tax profile. Log snippet: 
```
[12:41:03] POST /api/credits -> 200 {"id":"CN-9987","tax_rate":"20"}
[12:41:03] tax-normalizer: applied_rate=20% customer_profile=standard country=GB original_invoice_tax=0%
```
That would explain VAT on the credit.

maria-accounts: Also noticed the PO on the credit was `PD-0778` (extra zero) in our ledger, invoice had `PD-778`. That mismatch prevented automated apply to PO-controlled credits. Looks like a normalization bug when we sanitize purchaser inputs.

sam-eng: I think two bugs collided: (1) tax profile used is current instead of snapshot at invoice time, (2) PO string gets padded when we parse incoming webhook. Repro steps: 
1) Create invoice with tax_exempt flag via `/v1/invoices` and PO `PD-778`.
2) Mid-cycle change plan via `/v1/subscriptions/ops/downgrade` at T+10s.
3) Call `/v1/credits` to refund prorated amount. Observe credit.tax_rate != invoice.tax_rate and credit.po != invoice.po.
I'll open a tiny test that reproduces and attach.

billing-bot: Credit CN-9987 created by billing-service (amount=120.00 GBP, tax=20%, po=PD-0778) :money_with_wings:

liam-finance: Thanks. Two paths: (A) manual reversal of CN-9987, create CN-9991 with correct amount/tax/po and process refund to card (note: card might decline again); (B) issue corrected credit and apply to next invoice (safer if card declines). Need customer consent for option B but faster. Can we confirm effective prorated amount?

emma-support: Customer wants refund to card if possible — they already escalated. Card refund attempt earlier returned decline code `CARD_REFUND_DECLINED`. No useful bank response.

maria-accounts: If card refund fails we must issue adjusted credit note and apply to next invoice. I can manually create CN-9991 for 80.00 GBP tax 0% and link PO PD-778. Will need docs: original invoice, downgrade timestamp, and approval from head of billing.

sam-eng: I'll push a fix to use invoice tax snapshot when generating credits and stop padding PO strings in the webhook parser. Can we hold off automated retries for this customer until fix lands? I'll add a feature-flag gate for CN generation.

liam-finance: Action items:
- sam-eng: patch service to use invoice.tax_snapshot and normalize PO correctly (owner).
- maria-accounts: prepare manual CN-9991 (80.00 GBP, tax 0%) and hold until we try card refund again.
- emma-support: ask customer to confirm they prefer refund to card vs credit-to-account, and capture signed consent for manual refund.
- alex-engineer: run ledger-reconcile for account DataPulse after CN replacement, report any GL mismatches.

emma-support: Pinged customer, they confirmed refund to card preferred. Asked for signoff doc; they sent approval with PO reference.

liam-finance: OK — proceed with manual process but do not retry automated refund. maria, can you create the credit note and block any auto-apply?

maria-accounts: Creating CN-9991 now and will flag `no-auto-apply`. Uploading to ledger and emailing DataPulse copy.

emma-support: Noted. I'll update ticket and keep customer informed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

sam-eng: I'll ship a hotfix to billing-service in the next deploy window and follow-up with regression test.

liam-finance: Once CN-9991 is in, alex please run reconcile and file a short postmortem so ops doesn't auto-retry refund flows for PO-controlled accounts.

emma-support: closing loop here — customer notified, CN created, awaiting reconcile.
